content: Warren agents use the repository-local sd, ml, tr, and trellis toolchain for planning, expertise, triage, and readiness work; deliver changes commit-first before reporting completion.

name: Built preview route validation
description: The preview route check runs after the Astro static build, re-validates content/tina-fixture.json through assertHomeContent, and asserts the generated dist/index.html contains the semantic route landmarks and editorial ownership boundary. Keeping this as a quality step proves rendered output without adding a deployment or browser dependency.

name: Fixture boundary wiring verification
description: The preview content test verifies that the representative Astro route imports content/tina-fixture.json, validates it with assertHomeContent, and avoids environment or network adapter access; the built preview check verifies the rendered ownership note for senshac-content. This keeps the approved Tina fixture boundary explicit without introducing credentials or production configuration.

name: Preview exclusion gate
description: The preview quality contract now ends with repository:check, a deterministic scan that rejects secret-like files and assignments, private-key markers, generated deployment/Tina configuration, and non-placeholder site configuration; preview route checks remain fixture-backed and production integrations stay excluded.

name: Consolidated preview evidence boundary
description: After the route, fixture-boundary, and exclusion child Seeds complete, keep the parent preview checkpoint documentation-only: link each deterministic proof to its command, distinguish built-repository evidence from manual HTTP/browser/platform checks, and require human approval of a pinned read-only senshac-content adapter before any Tina write path or Pages/R2 production configuration.

name: Preview unknown-route HTTP contract
description: The deterministic preview check validates dist/404.html for semantic accessible branded output, then starts the built Astro preview and asserts GET /no-such-route returns HTTP 404 with the not-found heading and home link. This keeps the status contract covered without deployment configuration.

name: Tina dev generation boundary
description: The Tina Astro dev command generates tina/tina-lock.json plus transient tina/__generated__ and public/admin artifacts; track the lockfile and ignore the generated runtime artifacts. The minimal web schema models the pinned senshac-content export without adding Pages, DNS, or credentials.

name: Bun-based web contract workflow
description: The modular senshac-web contract workflow installs from the committed bun.lock with bun install --frozen-lockfile and executes bun run quality while retaining the immutable senshac-runner image and repository contract checks; the package build script remains astro build for Pages consistency.

content: Agent guidance is standardized in AGENTS.md with the portable .agents/skills/bounded-warren-task/SKILL.md; keep .warren/config.yaml's defaultProvider/defaultModel aligned (openrouter + openai/gpt-5.6-luna) without dropping the pinned agentImage digest.

title: Record modular cutover acceptance boundary
rationale: The final web review records deterministic route, content, Tina lock, safety, and quality evidence while explicitly leaving live platform, manual accessibility/SEO, media, and rollback rehearsal actions with owners. Keep tracker senshac-workspace-c714 in the delivery commit.
